jobs.title: Sekretär/in - Swiss Energy Program
Technisch-kaufmännische Fachperson Projekt Swiss Energy Program
jobs.description:
GIG Europe SA, ein Unternehmen der Tarchini-Gruppe, das sich mit der Planung, Entwicklung und Verwaltung von „grünen“ Energieanlagen befasst, sucht im Hinblick auf den Ausbau der eigenen Aktivitäten auf nationaler Ebene im Bereich der Energiespeicherung durch die Realisierung von BESS-Anlagen eine technisch-kaufmännische Fachperson für die Betreuung von Beziehungen und die Verhandlung von Grundstücksvereinbarungen zur Realisierung von BESS-Anlagen im Rahmen des Programms Swiss Energy Program.

Die ausgewählte Person wird Grundstücksflächen identifizieren, mit den Eigentümern der Grundstücke sowie mit den Betreibern der Stromnetze in Kontakt treten und Vereinbarungen über Baurechte für die Installation von BESS-Anlagen abschließen.

Anforderungen:

•
		Alter zwischen 30 und 40 Jahren

•
		Schweizer Staatsbürgerschaft oder Wohnsitz in der Schweiz

•
		sehr gute Kenntnisse in Italienisch, Deutsch, Schweizerdeutsch, Englisch und Französisch

•
		Erfahrung in Bereichen wie Immobilien, Energie, Infrastruktur oder verwandten Bereichen

•
		Bereitschaft zu häufigen Reisen in der ganzen Schweiz

•
		gute Kenntnisse des Schweizer Umfelds und Sensibilität für lokale Dynamiken

•
		ausgezeichnete Kommunikations-, Verhandlungs- und Repräsentationsfähigkeiten

•
		selbstständige Arbeitsweise

•
		technische Grundausbildung oder jedenfalls eine gute Vertrautheit mit Themen im Zusammenhang mit Energie, Anlagentechnik, Infrastruktur und Grundstücksfragen. Eine rein technische Spezialisierung ist nicht erforderlich; wichtig ist jedoch die Fähigkeit, das Projekt zu verstehen und es gegenüber externen Ansprechpartnern klar und glaubwürdig zu vermitteln

Wir bieten:

•
		Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag

•
		Beschäftigungsgrad 100%

•
		Arbeitsort: Manno – Deutschschweiz

•
		Stellenantritt: ab sofort

•
		Bereitschaft zu Reisen innerhalb der Schweiz

Bei Interesse senden Sie bitte Ihren Lebenslauf, Ihre Zeugnisse und ein Foto an:

GIG Europe SA

descriptionByLocale.it:
GIG Europe SA, società del Gruppo Tarchini, che si occupa della progettazione, dello sviluppo e della gestione di impianti energetici “verdi”, sta cercando uno specialista tecnico-commerciale per la gestione delle relazioni e la negoziazione di accordi terreni per la realizzazione di impianti BESS nell’ambito del Programma Energia Svizzera al fine di ampliare le proprie attività a livello nazionale nel settore dell’immagazzinamento energetico attraverso la realizzazione di impianti BESS.

La persona selezionata identificherà l'immobiliare, mettersi in contatto con i proprietari della terra, così come con gli operatori delle reti elettriche e concludere accordi sui diritti di costruzione per l'installazione delle strutture BESS.

Requisiti

•
Età tra i 30 e i 40 anni

•
Cittadinanza svizzera o residenza in Svizzera

•
conoscenza molto buona di italiano, tedesco, svizzero, inglese e francese

•
Esperienza in aree come immobili, energia, infrastrutture o aree correlate

•
Volontà di viaggiare frequentemente in tutta la Svizzera

•
buona conoscenza dell'ambiente svizzero e sensibilità alle dinamiche locali

•
eccellente capacità di comunicazione, negoziazione e rappresentanza

•
lavoratori autonomi

•
formazione tecnica di base o almeno una buona familiarità con i temi legati all'energia, alla tecnologia delle piante, alle infrastrutture e ai problemi della terra. Non è richiesta una specializzazione puramente tecnica; Ciò che è importante, tuttavia, è la capacità di comprendere il progetto e comunicarlo chiaramente e credibilmente ai contatti esterni.

Offriamo:

•
Contratto di durata indefinita

•
Livello di occupazione 100%

•
Ubicazione: Manno – Svizzera di lingua tedesca

•
Apertura del lavoro: da ora in poi

•
Volontà di viaggiare in Svizzera

Se sei interessato, invia il tuo CV, i tuoi certificati e una foto a:

GIG Europe SA

Centro Galleria 3

CH – 6928 Manno

Email: info@gigeurope.ch
descriptionByLocale.en:
GIG Europe SA, a company of the Tarchini Group, which deals with the planning, development and management of “green” energy plants, is looking for a technical-commercial specialist for the management of relationships and the negotiation of land agreements for the realization of BESS plants within the framework of the Swiss Energy Program with a view to expanding its own activities at national level in the field of energy storage through the realization of BESS plants.

The selected person will identify real estate, get in touch with the owners of the land, as well as with the operators of the power grids and conclude agreements on building rights for the installation of BESS facilities.

Requirements

•
Age between 30 and 40 years

•
Swiss citizenship or residence in Switzerland

•
very good knowledge of Italian, German, Swiss, English and French

•
Experience in areas such as real estate, energy, infrastructure or related areas

•
Willingness to travel frequently throughout Switzerland

•
good knowledge of the Swiss environment and sensitivity to local dynamics

•
excellent communication, negotiation and representation skills

•
self-employed persons

•
basic technical training or at least a good familiarity with topics related to energy, plant technology, infrastructure and land issues. A purely technical specialisation is not required; What is important, however, is the ability to understand the project and communicate it clearly and credibly to external contacts.

We offer:

•
Contract of indefinite duration

•
Employment level 100%

•
Location: Manno – German-speaking Switzerland

•
Job opening: from now on

•
Willingness to travel within Switzerland

If you are interested, please send your CV, your certificates and a photo to:

GIG Europe SA

Centro Galleria 3

CH – 6928 Manno

Email: info@gigeurope.ch

GIG Europe SA, une société du groupe Tarchini, qui s'occupe de la planification, du développement et de la gestion des centrales énergétiques de la région de Green, recherche un spécialiste technique-commercial pour la gestion des relations et la négociation d'accords fonciers pour la réalisation des centrales BESS dans le cadre du programme énergétique suisse en vue d'étendre ses propres activités au niveau national dans le domaine du stockage de l'énergie par la réalisation des centrales BESS.

La personne sélectionnée identifiera les biens immobiliers, communiquera avec les propriétaires du terrain, ainsi qu'avec les exploitants des réseaux électriques et conclura des accords sur les droits de construction pour l'installation des installations du BESS.

Exigences

•
Âge entre 30 et 40 ans

•
Citoyenneté ou résidence suisse en Suisse

•
très bonne connaissance de l'italien, allemand, suisse, anglais et français

•
Expérience dans des domaines tels que l'immobilier, l'énergie, l'infrastructure ou des domaines connexes

•
Volonté de voyager fréquemment dans toute la Suisse

•
bonne connaissance de l'environnement suisse et sensibilité à la dynamique locale

•
excellentes compétences en communication, négociation et représentation

•

•
formation technique de base ou au moins une bonne connaissance des sujets liés à l'énergie, la technologie végétale, l'infrastructure et les questions foncières. Une spécialisation purement technique n'est pas requise; Ce qui est important, cependant, c'est la capacité de comprendre le projet et de le communiquer clairement et de façon crédible aux contacts externes.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The Tarchini Group, active in Ticino in various sectors, from design to construction and management of buildings (industrial, commercial, logistics and residential) as well as the management of FoxTown in Mendrisio, in the context of strengthening its own staff and to support the growth of the Group is seeking a Junior Facility Manager. We are looking for a young and dynamic professional who is passionate about the construction and management of buildings and is able to work in a team. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background, excellent problem-solving skills, and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment. The Tarchini Group offers a competitive salary, a dynamic work environment, and opportunities for professional growth. If you are a motivated and organized individual who is passionate about the construction and management of buildings, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity. Job
• Requirements: * Maximum age of 35 years * Diploma in a technical field (building and/or plant engineering) * At least 5 years of experience in a similar position * Good knowledge of electrical systems, RVCS systems, and maintenance activities * Strong organizational skills and problem-solving abilities * Good knowledge of the Microsoft Office package in a Macintosh environment * Good knowledge and use of Autocad * Driving license Main
• Responsibilities: * Support to the Responsible * Conducting site visits, technical evaluations, and general estimates (construction, electrical, and RVCS systems) for the realization, modification, or restructuring of various types of sectors (offices, warehouses, production activities, etc.) directly for the Group or as a General Contractor for external clients * Coordination and direction of work * Control of heating and cooling systems * Control of maintenance contracts * Management and coordination of repairs * Management of direct workers and verification of their activities * Preparation of estimates and accounts * Contact with suppliers * Management of correspondence
• What we offer: * Interesting and dynamic work * Salary commensurate with abilities * Full-time employment * Location: Mendrisio * Immediate start Send your CV with certificates/attestations and photo to: Tarchini Consulting SA Center Galleria 3 CH-6928 Manno risorseumane@tarchinigroup.com

jobs.title: Sales Manager
jobs.description:
SALES MANAGER

Bancadati.ch

Bancadati is the carrier neutral Data Center in Lugano (Switzerland) that combines Swiss tradition with the latest technologies, to support every type of business in the Digital Transformation. The Data Center, with a 1.200 square meters surface, is a fully managed infrastructure designed to meet the highest technological standards aimed at energy efficiency, security and service continuity. Bancadati is the reliable partner in the national and international market that can offer different solutions to every Customer need.

Job Description

We are looking for a Sales Manager with technical and commercial skills to actively seek out and engage customers in Northern Italy and Switzerland, with an experience of at least 5 years in selling Co-location in the Italian or in the Swiss market. As Sales Manager, you will be responsible for growing our business by focusing on selling proper and appropriate solutions to every Customer. Next to that you will be responsible for the full sales lifecycle. You will be working closely with our sales, marketing team and technical support to successfully offer our solutions to the Italian and Swiss market.

Responsibilities

•
		Present, promote and sell solutions to new customers

•
		Achieve sales targets and outcomes within schedule

•
		Establish, develop and maintain positive business and customer relationships

•
		Supply management with reports on customer needs, problems, interests, competitive activities and potential for new products and services

Skills

•
		Strong Technical knowledge on Co-location

•
		Strong Sales experience in Data Centers and Co-location

•
		Clients hunter

•
		Strong communication and negotiation

•
		After sales relationship management

Requirements

•
		At least 5 years of experience in selling Co-location in the Italian or in the Swiss market

•
		Knowledge of Bancadati solutions

•
		Ability to travel in Italy or in Switzerland

•
		30-35 years old (please specify your age on your application)

•
		Swiss nationality or resident with valid work permit

•
		Languages: English and German (Italian is considered a plus)

Information

•
		Place of work: Manno and visits to Clients in Italy or Switzerland

•
		Starting date: to be agreed

•
		Full time job

SALES MANAGER

Bancadati.ch

Bancadati is the carrier neutral Data Center in Lugano (Switzerland) that combines Swiss tradition with the latest technologies, to support every type of business in the Digital Transformation. The Data Center, with a 1.200 square meters surface, is a fully managed infrastructure designed to meet the highest technological standards aimed at energy efficiency, security and service continuity. Bancadati is the reliable partner in the national and international market that can offer different solutions to every Customer need.

Job Description

We are looking for a Sales Manager with technical and commercial skills to actively seek out and engage customers in Northern Italy and Switzerland, with an experience of at least 5 years in selling Co-location in the Italian or in the Swiss market. As Sales Manager, you will be responsible for growing our business by focusing on selling proper and appropriate solutions to every Customer. Next to that you will be responsible for the full sales lifecycle. You will be working closely with our sales, marketing team and technical support to successfully offer our solutions to the Italian and Swiss market.

Responsibilities

•
Present, promote and sell solutions to new customers

•
Achieve sales targets and outcomes within schedule

•
Establish, develop and maintain positive business and customer relationships

•
Supply management with reports on customer needs, problems, interests, competitive activities and potential for new products and services

Skills

•
Strong Technical knowledge on Co-location

•
Strong Sales experience in Data Centers and Co-location

•
Clients hunter

•
Strong communication and negotiation

•
After sales relationship management

Requirements

•
At least 5 years of experience in selling Co-location in the Italian or in the Swiss market

•
Knowledge of Bancadati solutions

•
Ability to travel in Italy or in Switzerland

•
30-35 years old (please specify your age on your application)

•
Swiss nationality or resident with valid work permit

•
Languages: English and German (Italian is considered a plus)

Information

•
Place of work: Manno and visits to Clients in Italy or Switzerland

•
Starting date: to be agreed

•
Full time job

info@tarchinigroup.com
